current_component_sources.quote: Quantum broadcasting within a complete-profile class. Every full-Choi-rank channel has an explicitly compiled representative with the same complete maximal/RLD profile and a symmetric extension to any prescribed finite number of receivers. The two-receiver case gives an antidegradable, zero-capacity representative. The actual heralded inverse and its success probability are included; failed unknown inputs remain consumed. The rank-deficient converse remains open.
